sources.title: The Balch | Creepy Fingers Effects
sources.excerpt: $ 249.00 Balch Add to Cart The signature fuzz pedal from Bob Balch of Fu Manchu. Original Creepy Fingers design. High gain silicon gated fuzz. Raspy, glitchy, and fuzzy. Bottom knob adjusts low end from thin buzz to crushing lows. New 3 color silkscreen design. Steel enclosures made in the U.S.A. True bypass switching and switchcraft jacks. Common negative ground effect powerable by battery or external power supply.

sources.title: Here it is! Demo video of “The Balch” an original fuzz design from Creepy Fingers effects. Available in November. Watch the video for pre-order info. | Fu Manchu
